description: Points agents to the outline skill; Outline deletes need a person's confirmation; new collections are made workspace-visible; optional session log (off unless configured).

hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "Outline wiki: before creating, editing or deleting anything in Outline, load the `outline` skill (claude-outline plugin) and follow it."}}'
printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Outline delete: confirm the exact item before it is removed."}}'

grep -q -E 'api/(collections|documents|comments|attachments|shares|users)\.(delete|archive)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Outline delete via the REST API: confirm the exact item before it is removed."}}' || true
